task: v1.1 Phase 12, task 12.2 - Allowlist resolution and renderer filtering order (ADR-017 clauses 2, 3, 4)
subject: Per-selector badge value allowlist filter: exact case-insensitive ordinal match against the resolved pre-template value, applied before the definition template and before layout.

findings.summary: No single test drives a non-empty per-selector allowlist from PluginConfiguration through PluginConfigurationSnapshot/RendererConfigurationResolver into the resolved selection; the two seams are covered separately, so the composition is only implicitly verified.
evidence: tests/ArrTags.Tests/BadgeAllowlistFilterTests.cs constructs BadgeDefinition objects directly (e.g. Quality(...)/Audio(...) helpers) and never obtains them from a PluginConfigurationSnapshot.

tests/ArrTags.Tests/RendererConfigurationTests.cs:363 ValidatorAcceptsAndResolvesAllowedValues and :383 ValidatorTrimsAllowedValueEntries assert config -> snapshot.BadgeDefinitions[selector].AllowedValues only; they do not call BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve.
tests/ArrTags.Tests/RendererConfigurationIntegrationTests.cs:52 resolves config -> snapshot -> real coordinator but exercises a disabled selector and palette only, with an empty allowlist.

src/ArrTags/Configuration/RendererConfigurationResolver.cs:101 passes entry.AllowedValues straight into BadgeDefinition, and src/ArrTags/Rendering/BadgeDefinitionResolver.cs:59 applies the filter, so the seams are simple and each is covered.
The acceptance criterion (PLANS.md task 12.2) is literally 'A configured allowlist restricts rendering to the listed values'.
findings.recommended_action: Optional: add one integration assertion (for example extend RendererConfigurationIntegrationTests or add a case that builds a PluginConfiguration with Quality.AllowedValues={"Bluray-1080p"}, resolves it through PluginConfigurationSnapshot, and asserts BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve excludes a non-allowlisted value). Not required to establish the behavior; both seams are independently covered and the mapping is a direct property pass-through.

findings.summary: The allowlist assertions are on the resolved selection (TechnicalValues/StatusValue) and on layout pills, not on rendered pixels; the native Skia renderer path is environment-guarded and skipped in the default matrix.
evidence: tests/ArrTags.Tests/BadgeAllowlistFilterTests.cs asserts selection.TechnicalValues and StatusValue (the exact values the renderer consumes).
tests/ArrTags.Tests/RendererBehaviorTruncationTests.cs:87 AnAllowlistedValueThatCannotFitStillFollowsTheOmitBehavior asserts layout.TechnicalPills empty via BadgeLayoutEngine.Build (pure, unguarded).
src/ArrTags/Rendering/SkiaBadgeRenderer.cs:82 and src/ArrTags/Artwork/ArtworkRegenerationPlanner.cs:173 both call BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve, so the tested layer is the real filtering path.
The native pixel path (SkiaBadgeRendererRenderTests, RenderGoldenTests) is [SkiaNativeFact]/[SkiaNativeTheory] and skipped without ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1 (documented limitation V6).
findings.recommended_action: None. Selection-level assertions are the correct observable layer given the documented native-Skia environment limitation; task 12.4 owns golden regeneration and task 14.3 owns the live-host run.

summary: The task 12.2 test suite genuinely establishes the ADR-017 allowlist filter behavior. All required behaviors are covered by unguarded facts: exact case-insensitive ordinal match, trim, no substring/prefix/wildcard/regex, per-retained custom value, full audio composite with component-alone rejection, fixed UpgradePending text, empty allowlist = no restriction, unknown/absent omitted unchanged, filter-before-template order, and allowlisted-but-unfittable still shortens/omits. Five independent source mutations (always-allow, substring, case-sensitive, filter-after-template, status-filter-removed) each fail one or more tests, so the suite is non-vacuous. The default suite independently reproduces the documented matrix (Failed 0, Passed 1445, Skipped 63, Total 1508) and all 63 skips are environment-guarded with none covering allowlist behavior and no new skips introduced. Tests are deterministic and isolated, and the assertions target the real production filtering path (selection and layout pills). The only finding is a LOW coverage observation that no single test composes a non-empty allowlist from PluginConfiguration through the snapshot/resolver into the selection; both seams are separately covered, so this is optional hardening rather than a correctness gap. PASS_WITH_FINDINGS; ready for the next task.
